QUOTE: "if !auto_ok and on_tool_call set → approved = true" and "With a callback registered, the only way a call is refused is the deny list."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says an unmatched call is approved when a callback is registered, because the callback cannot deny, so only the deny list refuses. That is default-allow in effect. The no-callback denial it also mentions is a caveat and doesn't change that.
